messages:
jordan: Quick heads-up — planning a coordinated version bump across API, runtime, console, and SDKs to v0.14. Cutoff for changelog + PRs is 17:00 PT today. Can owners post status and callouts?

maya: Console PR is green but there's one doc change still pending (changelog entry). I can finish by 16:20 PT.

lee: Runtime has a perf tweak landed but needs a small patch to the compatibility matrix. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/482 — also needs a manual verify on the quantization path. ETA ~16:45.

sam: API SDKs — Python and TS bumps ready, but the TS SDK CI is flaking on e2e. CI job: `npm run test:e2e` failing intermittently. Debugging now, should have a fix or revert by 16:10.

jordan: Thanks — sounds like we're close. If CI doesn't stabilize, we can gate TS SDK and still cut API/runtime/console, then do a follow-up patch for SDKs. Preference is to avoid split versions but safety first.

ci-bot: [CI] runtime PR #482 passed unit tests, integration queued (job id: 99821).

ops-bot: Scheduled cut job window reserved at 17:15 PT (15m slot). Please ensure tags and changelog entries are merged before 17:00 PT to be included.

maya: Adding changelog snippet now under `docs/CHANGELOG.md`:

```
Console v0.14.0 — UI: Add versioned telemetry opt-in; Fix: dropdown rendering at 2x DPI
```

lee: Manual verify done on quant path — no regressions on short sequences. Merging compatibility matrix fix now.

sam: TS SDK: found a flaky test (timeout). Increased jest timeout in test and pushed fix: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-ts/pull/211 — CI retry kicked off.

ci-bot: [CI] SDK-TS PR #211 passed, all checks green.

jordan: Perfect. Final checklist for cut:
- All PRs merged (console, runtime, api, sdk-ts, sdk-py)
- Tags created: `v0.14.0` on each repo
- Changelog entries present
- Release notes draft in GH release for API and Console

maya: Confirmed merged and tag ready for Console.

lee: Runtime merged and tagged. Release notes stubbed in release draft.

sam: SDKs merged, python package ready. TS tag pushed.

jordan: OK launching cut in ops window at 17:15 PT. @ops-bot please proceed, and if anything blocks, ping #eng-oncall and this thread. :rocket:

ops-bot: Starting release job in 5m. Will post status updates here.

ci-bot: [release] console v0.14.0 build succeeded.

ops-bot: All releases published. Release notes links: https://github.com/redwood/console/releases/tag/v0.14.0 , https://github.com/redwood/runtime/releases/tag/v0.14.0 , https://pypi.org/project/redwood-api/0.14.0/

jordan: Huge thanks — smooth cut. If anyone notices downstream regressions, open a hotfix PR and mention this thread. :thumbsup:
